races.name: Summer Social Events At Southwell Racecourse Handicap

runners_data.name: Clansman
runners_data.note: Front-runner with proven stamina at this trip but faces three tactical hold-up horses who can exploit his steady early pace

runners_data.name: Betelgeuse
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist carrying 7lbs less than top weight with solid recent form over similar distances on standard going

runners_data.name: Westlain
runners_data.note: Long layoff of 293 days is major concern despite headgear changes, though has shown stamina at longer distances previously

runners_data.name: Volcanic Rock
runners_data.note: High-class prominent runner from powerful stable but significant weight burden and 68-day break raise fitness questions

runners_data.name: Dollar's Dream
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up horse getting 17lbs from top weight with strong recent form over similar trips and conditions

races.paceDynamic: Clansman will dictate terms from the front without serious pressure, setting a sustainable gallop over this extended trip. With three hold-up horses (Betelgeuse, Westlain, Dollar's Dream) and only Volcanic Rock likely to race prominently behind the leader, Clansman faces minimal early harassment. The pace will be steady rather than searching, creating a tactical race where stamina and finishing kick become paramount. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can capitalise on the modest early pace and Clansman's likely vulnerability in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Clansman sets his usual steady pace without pressure from Volcanic Rock
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the three hold-up runners will prove decisive as they swarm past a tiring leader. Betelgeuse and Dollar's Dream, both showing recent form, can exploit their weight advantages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Clansman gets an easy lead and finds reserves when challenged
scenarios.body: His proven stamina at this trip and recent consistency allow him to repel late challenges. The hold-up horses leave themselves too much to do against a horse who knows how to win.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Volcanic Rock tracks Clansman closely and kicks clear before the hold-up horses can respond
scenarios.body: The Godolphin runner's class advantage tells as he times his move perfectly between the steady early pace and late flourish. His prominent style proves the perfect tactical compromise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Long Layoff Winner
scenarios.trigger: If Westlain overcomes his 293-day absence with a bold front-running performance
scenarios.body: The headgear change and return to longer distances spark improvement as he presses Clansman early. His stamina reserves from the long break prove decisive in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Clansman must be monitored for early pace pressure from Volcanic Rock which could compromise his stamina reserves
Westlain's ability to handle the 293-day layoff will be evident within the first half-mile of racing
Dollar's Dream's weight advantage of 17lbs could prove decisive if the pace develops as expected
Volcanic Rock's fitness after 68 days off needs assessing given his prominent running style demands peak condition
Betelgeuse showed improved form last time and any market confidence would be significant given his tactical advantage

races.name: Book The Bistro In Sherwood Restaurant EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Come Racing For Free 18th June Handicap

runners_data.name: Flash Kozo
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who needs a strong pace to be effective, 39 days off but has shown his best form fresh with Kieran Shoemark.

runners_data.name: Al's River
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who has been consistent lately, 21-day break should have him spot-on for James Horton who's having a quiet spell.

runners_data.name: Extraterrestrial
runners_data.note: Handy type wearing a tongue tie for the first time, Simon & Ed Crisford runner with solid recent form over this trip on similar going.

runners_data.name: Magician Of Riga
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who won last time in similar conditions, Richard Hannon's 5 winners from 49 runners shows stable form is mixed.

runners_data.name: Gemical
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 191 days off, has shown a tendency to fade in the finish which is concerning after such a break.

runners_data.name: Wave Power
runners_data.note: Another hold-up type having first run for 202 days, will need the leaders to come back to him significantly to be competitive.

runners_data.name: Singarda
runners_data.note: Patient racer who has been running consistently without winning, 13-day turnaround suggests connections are happy with his condition.

races.paceDynamic: Magician Of Riga is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms uncontested, creating a moderate but sustainable gallop through the middle sections. Al's River and Extraterrestrial are the only prominent racers to apply any pressure, but both have shown they're comfortable tracking rather than forcing. The four hold-up horses - Flash Kozo, Gemical, Wave Power, and Singarda - will be bunched together off the pace, relying on the final 3-4 furlongs to make their challenge. This uncontested lead scenario heavily favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without expending energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Magician Of Riga gets an easy lead without early pressure from the prominent pair.
scenarios.body: The front runner controls fractions and has plenty left for the finish, while hold-up horses face too much ground to make up. Prominent racers get the best of both worlds - close enough to strike but not doing the donkey work.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Finish Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the sustainable pace allows closers to get into contention turning for home.
scenarios.body: Flash Kozo's hold-up style becomes effective as the pace-setters tire, with the best finishers able to pick off the leaders. The uncontested early pace leaves something for the patient riders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Applied
scenarios.trigger: If Al's River or Extraterrestrial decide to challenge Magician Of Riga earlier than expected.
scenarios.body: The increased gallop stretches the field and compromises both front runner and hold-up horses, favouring those who can stay handy without leading. This tactical battle opens the door for the best-positioned prominent runner.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Drama
scenarios.trigger: If Magician Of Riga goes too slowly and creates a sprint finish from the back.
scenarios.body: The crawling pace brings every horse into contention at the furlong pole, creating chaos and favouring those with natural speed regardless of style. Late drama as the field bunches for a cavalry charge.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Al's River or Extraterrestrial putting early pressure on Magician Of Riga - if either tracks closer than usual, it transforms the race dynamics completely.
Monitor Flash Kozo's position turning for home - if he's not within 6-8 lengths of the leader at the 3-furlong pole, his chance is gone.
Keep an eye on the fractions Magician Of Riga sets - if he goes too fast early or too slow throughout, it compromises his winning chance.
Watch for any market moves on Gemical or Wave Power - both are returning from long breaks and any support suggests hidden fitness.
Observe Extraterrestrial's response to the tongue tie - first-time headgear can either sharpen focus or cause distraction in the preliminaries.

races.paceDynamic: Donna Nook will set the pace from the front with minimal pressure, likely joined by fellow prominent runners Alessia Fernanda and Cosi Bear tracking close behind. The small field and lack of confirmed pace pressers means Donna Nook can dictate comfortable fractions throughout the mile trip. This controlled tempo will favour hold-up horses like Welljudged, Brave Byreflection, Dream Illusion, Wondrous Light and Special Breeze who can finish strongly. The race shape strongly favours closers who can unleash late kicks against a modest early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Finish Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate throughout allowing closers maximum impact
scenarios.body: Dream Illusion and Welljudged can utilise their proven finishing kicks against the controlled early tempo. The hold-up brigade gets ideal conditions to showcase their turn of foot.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Group Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Donna Nook maintains steady fractions without being pressured early
scenarios.body: The pace-setter can resist late challenges with Alessia Fernanda and Cosi Bear providing tactical support. Early positioning proves decisive with closers leaving their runs too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Acceleration
scenarios.trigger: If prominent runners increase the tempo from halfway creating a true test
scenarios.body: Brave Byreflection's higher TopSpeed rating becomes crucial as the race develops into a genuine stamina test. Horses with tactical speed rather than pure finishing kicks benefit from the honest pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes extremely sedate turning into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Electric Avenue's all-weather experience and Wondrous Light's recent winning form become decisive factors. The race becomes about who has the most explosive final furlong rather than sustained finishing kicks.

watchPoints.text: Donna Nook's 93-day layoff could see her lose the lead if fitness tells against fresher rivals
Electric Avenue's trainer running at 0/24 strike-rate suggesting stable in poor form
Dream Illusion's recent course win and consistent placings make her dangerous if getting the expected pace setup
Alessia Fernanda's 188-day absence and headgear changes create uncertainty despite prominent running style
Welljudged's perfect record on similar going conditions makes her a major player if the pace develops as expected

races.paceDynamic: Kondratiev Wave appears the sole confirmed front runner with several prominent racers (Shaws Phoenix, Pink Socks, Kessaar Power) likely to press early. This creates a moderate pace scenario where the leader won't get an easy time, particularly with Daniel Muscutt on The Spotlight Kid and Jack Mitchell on Borderline Madness both capable of tactical positioning from their hold-up styles. The race sets up as a tactical affair where those able to get good positions without using too much energy early will benefit. This pace dynamic strongly favours prominent racers and forward hold-up horses who can avoid the early scrimmaging while staying within striking distance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners (Shaws Phoenix, Pink Socks, Kessaar Power) all press Kondratiev Wave from the start creating genuine tempo.
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will suit horses with tactical speed who can sit handy without being caught in the early battle. Forward hold-up types like The Spotlight Kid and Borderline Madness benefit from the strong pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If Kondratiev Wave gets left alone early with the prominent runners sitting and waiting, creating a slow tempo.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where horses with the best turn of foot and tactical positioning will dominate. This suits the classier hold-up horses who can quicken sharply off a steady pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Honest Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If one or two prominent runners engage Kondratiev Wave but others drop back, creating an even tempo throughout.
scenarios.body: This even pace allows prominent racers with staying power to maintain their position and kick on in the straight. Horses like Pink Socks and Kessaar Power can utilize their forward positions effectively.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Start Impacts
scenarios.trigger: If the large field causes interference or bunching early, disrupting the natural pace flow and positions.
scenarios.body: Horses drawn well who avoid trouble and maintain good positioning will have significant advantages regardless of running style. Experience and jockey skill become crucial factors in navigating the chaos.

watchPoints.text: If Shaws Phoenix shows unexpected sharpness despite the long layoff, it could disrupt the entire pace scenario by pressing Kondratiev Wave harder than expected
The Spotlight Kid's position early will be crucial - if Muscutt gets caught wide or too far back, the strong course record becomes irrelevant
Ring Of Gold's visor retention suggests connections expect another bold show, and the low weight makes this horse very dangerous if the pace unfolds correctly
Any early interference in this 11-runner field could benefit the experienced campaigners like Kondratiev Wave and Ring Of Gold who handle crowded conditions better
Kessaar Power with De Sousa aboard represents the strongest jockey-horse combination for tactical positioning if the race becomes messy

races.paceDynamic: Our Misty Blue will lead alone from the gates with no other confirmed pace-setters, creating an uncontested front-running scenario. The prominent runners Heretic, Ribston Pippin, and Back From Dubai will track behind but unlikely to pressure the leader early. This sets up a sustainable pace that will heavily favour the hold-up horses who can finish strongly in the final two furlongs. The race shape clearly benefits closers and hold-up performers over front-runners and prominent racers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Our Misty Blue sets moderate fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final furlong as the leader fades, allowing the strong-finishing hold-up brigade to sweep past. Timely Affair and Spirit Of Bowland are perfectly positioned to capitalise.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Heretic or Ribston Pippin apply early pressure to Our Misty Blue
scenarios.body: The pace quickens from halfway but remains honest enough for a prominent runner to kick clear. Heretic's recent form and stable strike rate make him the most likely beneficiary.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader holds on
scenarios.trigger: If Our Misty Blue gets completely uncontested fractions and finds reserves
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows Our Misty Blue to store enough energy to resist the late charge. However, the leader's fading tendency makes this unlikely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop is crawling and becomes tactical
scenarios.body: The race turns into a sprint from the two-furlong pole with the best turn of foot prevailing. This scenario could favour an outsider with natural speed.

watchPoints.text: Our Misty Blue could steal the race if given completely uncontested fractions and finds improvement from the tongue-tie
Timely Affair with Oisin Murphy represents the strongest hold-up threat if the pace scenario unfolds as expected
Heretic's early position will be crucial - if positioned too close to Our Misty Blue the pace could quicken significantly
Spirit Of Bowland needs to be delivered with one run from the back given the likely slow early gallop
Unknown Journey's headgear debut could spark improvement but trainer's 20% strike rate demands respect

races.paceDynamic: Gold Star Gazing will set a comfortable pace from the front with no obvious pressure, supported by the prominent runners Hugh, Likeadyinwasp, and Agric Ranger who should track close behind. The lack of multiple front runners means Gold Star Gazing can dictate terms without being stretched early, creating a sustainable tempo that builds gradually. With hold-up horses like Wezzeer and Forest Phoenix needing the pace to collapse, and the likely even gallop, this race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can stay close to the pace throughout.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Gold Star Gazing maintains the lead unchallenged through steady fractions
scenarios.body: The pace-setter can dictate comfortable splits and prove hard to peg back in the straight. Prominent trackers get first run on any faltering leader while hold-up horses are left with too much to do.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes slightly stronger than expected with more pressure on Gold Star Gazing
scenarios.body: Hugh and Likeadyinwasp can sit in perfect stalking positions before launching late challenges. The front runner may just weaken enough for these prominent runners to strike in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Unknown Quantity Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If either Elite Approach or Sugar Bon Bon possess significant undisclosed ability from their connections
scenarios.body: These lightly raced runners could have natural pace to track the leaders and superior class to win. Their unknown running styles make them dangerous wild cards in a moderate contest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with multiple horses pressuring Gold Star Gazing
scenarios.body: Wezzeer and Forest Phoenix could benefit from increased pace that sets up their closing kicks. The front runners would need to collapse significantly for this scenario to unfold.

watchPoints.text: Gold Star Gazing could steal this if allowed uncontested lead given the lack of early pace pressure

races.paceDynamic: Shazani is the only confirmed front-runner in this field and should be able to dictate terms without pressure, setting a sustainable pace from the start. Tabby and Belsito are the only prominent racers who might track close, but neither has the pace to challenge Shazani early. The majority of the field (Glamour Show, Fan Mail, Dicko The Legend, Thurso, Neyva's Angel) are hold-up performers who will need the pace to develop. This tactical scenario strongly favours front-running and prominent racing styles, as they can control the race without early pressure and kick clear of the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Shazani Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Shazani gets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady tempo
scenarios.body: The front-runner can dictate fractions without pressure and have enough left to resist the late charge from the hold-up horses. With most of the field needing pace to aim at, Shazani's tactical advantage becomes decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Tabby or Belsito can sit close to Shazani and time their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The prominent racers benefit from the honest pace set by Shazani while avoiding the traffic problems that could affect the hold-up horses. Their superior tactical position allows them to strike at the right moment.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Revival
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too slow and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The mass of hold-up horses get the tactical scenario they need with a steadily-run race setting up a cavalry charge. Glamour Show and Fan Mail could benefit from their higher RPRs in this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Shazani goes too fast early trying to shake off the field
scenarios.body: The front-runner burns out from over-racing and the field comes back to engulf the leader in the final furlong. This unlikely scenario would need Shazani to panic tactically.
